name: motion-j-l-cut
title: J-cut / L-cut
description: Bài học: tiếng của cảnh sau vào trước hình 4–12 khung (J-cut), hoặc tiếng của cảnh trước còn kéo dài 12–24 khung sau điểm cắt (L-cut).

moworks.author: moworks

options.loop: s for the playhead to cross the 3 s ruler (3)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Diagram on neutral bars: a picture track (A dark / B accent, cut at the middle) over an audio track, two rows. J row: audio B starts 4-12 frames before the picture cut (demo ~0.3 s early); L row: audio A runs 12-24 frames past it (~0.3 s late); a yellow line marks the cut. A playhead sweeps the 3 s ruler linearly, looping. Params: lead: tiếng trước (4–12 khung) · trail: tiếng sau (12–24 khung). A lesson as a diagram: picture over sound; the J row's sound of B starts before the cut, the L row's sound of A runs past it. In a film: place the voice clip a few frames early or late against the scene cut.
